title: Keep service available after serialization failure

context.hint: Handle serialization failures after client JSON parsing without losing the session server.
context.surface: An authenticated session server serializes client events for logs and local event storage.
assumptions: A client must hold the session credential.
Use a disposable local authenticated session and bounded test inputs.

review.invariant: A parsed client event that cannot be serialized does not terminate the session process.
review.verification: Submit a bounded event that exercises the serialization error path in a disposable authenticated session. Verify that the process survives and serves a subsequent authenticated HTTP request.

source_observation.summary: The baseline session process exited on an uncaught serialization error. After repair, the same regression completed and the server continued serving authenticated HTTP. This is a session availability finding.
